_comment: THE HUMAN MUST BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE ESSENCE DEPLETER THEMSELVES. Same board as
edf_blink_loop_cashes_drain.json, guarding the OTHER half of the 2026-09-04 user report:
"It seems you cannot activate Essence Depleter yourself."
Two independent things had to be true for that sentence to be false, and this fixture pins the
one a static board CAN pin: that the drain is ENUMERATED at all. It is an activated ability with
no {T} in its cost, so it is repeatable within a turn and bounded only by mana -- the menu should
offer it whenever it is payable. Evidence it was not: in the user's saved turn-3 win (54
decisions) the Depleter sat on the battlefield for 10 decision frames and its activation was
offered ZERO times; the only verb in the entire log is `blink`.
verdict=choose with 4 variants, not accept: ManaSinkActivationCounts offers the generic 1..3
plus one 'finish it' count, and CheckLine reports several matching plans as a sub-decision for
the human to pick among. That IS the affordance working -- an `accept` here would mean the count
fan-out had collapsed.
WHAT THIS FIXTURE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT COVER. The user's actual failure needed the mana to be
FLOATING `wild` from a mid-loop tap-ahead: a rainbow source (Aether Hub) was credited as bare
`wild` with no ManaPool::wild_c, so CanPayFlat's colourless deficit could not be met, {1}{C} was
unpayable, and an unpayable cost is an UNENUMERATED action. This board has real untapped {C}
sources (a 0-energy Aether Hub is a colourless source; Mariposa Military Base makes {C}), so the
drain is payable from the pool and the fixture passes with MTG_REFLOAT_WILD_C=0 too. It guards
the affordance, NOT the wild_c repair -- that one is covered by the A/B in
docs/design/analysis-EldraziDisplacerFlicker.md section 14. Said plainly so nobody later reads a
green run here as proof the credit bug is fixed.
